# Mr. Picked

> Mr. Picked helps restaurants, cafés and hotels get recommended by AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity, and rank better on Google. We work in 6 languages (English, Slovenian, Croatian, Italian, German, Hungarian) for businesses in Slovenia, Croatia, Italy, Austria and Hungary.

## What we do

- AI Mirror audit: we ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google’s AI answers the questions guests really ask (30 questions in 6 languages) and show where the business appears, where competitors appear instead, and what the AI gets wrong.
- Fix in the first 30 days: Google Business Profile, opening hours, menu, photos, categories; listings corrected on 15+ platforms (TripAdvisor, Apple Maps, Bing, TheFork and others); machine-readable menu and booking info on the website.
- Stay recommended: monthly Mr. Picked Report with an AI visibility score, AI-made short videos from the business’s real photos with voiceover and subtitles in 6 languages, review requests after each visit, and replies to Google reviews.
- Optional: WhatsApp concierge that answers guests and takes bookings 24/7, and an AI-ready multilingual website.

## Packages (per month, excl. VAT)

- Visible — 390 EUR: AI audit and full fix in 30 days, listings on 15+ platforms, local Google SEO for 10 key searches, 4 Google profile posts a month, monthly report.
- Recommended — 690 EUR: everything in Visible plus 2 AI videos a month in 3 languages, automatic review requests, review replies within 48 h, 50 guest questions and 3 competitors tracked, quarterly results call.
- Concierge — 990 EUR + 490 EUR one-time setup: everything in Recommended plus 4 AI videos a month in 6 languages, WhatsApp concierge 24/7, booking reminders and no-show follow-up, menu online in 6 languages, monthly strategy call.
- Add-ons: AI video pack +3 videos 149 EUR/month; review loop 90 EUR/month; WhatsApp concierge 390 EUR/month + 490 EUR setup; AI-ready website from 1,490 EUR one-off.
- Monthly contracts, cancel with 30 days’ notice. Promise: higher AI and Google visibility in 90 days, or the fourth month is free.

## Languages

The site is available in English (https://mrpicked.eu/), Slovenian (https://mrpicked.eu/sl/), Croatian (https://mrpicked.eu/hr/), Italian (https://mrpicked.eu/it/), German (https://mrpicked.eu/de/) and Hungarian (https://mrpicked.eu/hu/).

## Free AI check

Any business can request a free AI Mirror report at https://mrpicked.eu/ and receive it within 48 hours, with an optional call to go through the results.
